findings.title: Null dereference in handler
findings.reasoning: user.profile may be null; accessing .name will throw at runtime.
findings.reproduction: Send a request from a user with no profile attached.
findings.whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Existing tests only construct users with a profile.
findings.suggestedRegressionTest: Test handleRequest with a user that has profile=null.
findings.minimumFixScope: Add a null guard around line 42 in src/handler.ts.

notes: reviewed entrypoint and one downstream call site
